title: Audit remaining wall-clock defaults: deaddrop, rangetest, RollcallResource
description: Discovered during a6qg work: deaddrop.py:82 and rangetest.py:126 share the SosResource/ConfessionsResource time.time-default pattern (dead-drop spec 18.9 also mandates monotonic uptime), and RollcallResource hardcodes int(time.time()) non-injectably. Out of a6qg scope; audit and align defaults + injectability.
